name: list_specs
description: Lists specs in the library matching a filter. Use for queries like 'what's in review', 'specs owned by jane.doe', 'all component specs'. Do NOT use to fetch a single known SPEC ID — use Read on specs/<id>.md for that. Returns a compact table of id, title, status, owner, type, updated.

owner.description: Filter to specs owned by this username. Omit for all owners.

title_match.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the title.
